scope: Official-source UI candidate and license reference only; no vendor code, starter, packages, or completed task solution bundled.
selection_policy: Read the task README, existing source, package.json, lockfile and actual runtimes first.
Fix existing bugs and one required end-to-end flow before restyling.
Keep the existing framework and package manager; add at most one demonstrated UI dependency at a time.
Use approved local packages/assets, preserve licenses and lockfiles, and avoid runtime CDN/fonts/analytics.
Public-code inbound permission does not permit uploading task data, source, logs or artifacts to remote tools.
No personal API key, external generation service or deployment is required.
license_note: Licenses below describe the linked OSS projects as reviewed, not every paid product, template, registry item, dependency or future release. Check the selected version and retain applicable notices.

candidates.name: shadcn/ui
candidates.role: Customizable UI components and component-code distribution
candidates.choose_when: Existing React or supported framework setup can adopt a small set of required components.
candidates.avoid_when: Adoption would regenerate or migrate a working application merely for its appearance.
notes: Inspect generated source and dependencies; do not replace the whole app.
A third-party registry item has its own license and trust boundary.

candidates.name: Radix Primitives
candidates.role: Low-level accessible interaction primitives such as dialogs, menus and tabs
candidates.choose_when: The existing compatible UI needs focus/keyboard behavior with custom styling.
candidates.avoid_when: A fully styled theme or non-React framework replacement is expected.
notes: Primitives are unstyled; verify accessibility after composition and customization.

candidates.name: daisyUI
candidates.role: Tailwind CSS component classes and themes
candidates.choose_when: Existing HTML, Vue, Svelte or server-rendered templates can reuse a compatible local CSS build.
candidates.avoid_when: The environment lacks a permitted compatible build path and existing CSS is sufficient.
notes: React is not required for CSS classes.
The documented npm plugin path requires Node and Tailwind; confirm actual versions.
Do not depend on remote runtime CDN CSS or paid templates.

candidates.name: Lucide
candidates.role: SVG icons with packages for multiple frameworks
candidates.choose_when: A few consistent icons clarify existing buttons and navigation.
candidates.avoid_when: Icons would replace necessary text labels or add an unnecessary framework.
additional_notices: The upstream LICENSE also includes MIT terms and attribution for listed Feather-derived icons; preserve applicable full notices.
notes: Use the package matching the existing stack or approved local SVG assets.
Provide accessible labels for icon-only actions.

candidates.name: Recharts
candidates.choose_when: An already-React application needs a justified line, bar or other data chart.
candidates.avoid_when: Adding React or a migration would be required just to draw one chart.
notes: Check actual React and peer-dependency compatibility, chart container dimensions, units and source numbers.

candidates.name: Tailwind CSS
candidates.role: Utility CSS styling and responsive layout
candidates.choose_when: Already installed or a compatible local CSS pipeline is justified.
candidates.avoid_when: Existing CSS is sufficient or adoption would force a major-version migration.
notes: Not a prebuilt application or complete component library.
The OSS core license does not automatically cover separate commercial Plus/Pro products.
